name: Hel Ra Citadel
summary: Hel Ra Citadel is an ancient Yokudan fortress in southwestern Craglorn. It has been taken over by The Warrior and his Anka-Ra armies, having been corrupted by The Serpent. Hel Ra Citadel Hard Mode can be triggered by entering the Veteran version of the trial and destroying the statues in the room before the Warrior's chamber. Completing a full run of Veteran Hel Ra Citadel will reward 12 Undaunted Plunder worth 12000 gold total (2 from Ra Kotu, 2 from Yokeda Kai or Yokeda Rok'dun, and 8 from The Warrior). You will receive a Star-Studded Champion's Baldric for defeating The Warrior with hard mode active.

achievements.name: Time Trial: Hel Ra Citadel

achievements.name: Hel Ra Citadel Conqueror

achievements.name: Hel Ra Citadel Difficult Mode
achievements.description: Defeat the Celestial Warrior after enraging him through the destruction of his statue army.

achievements.name: Hel Ra Citadel: The War Horn
achievements.description: Sound the war horn at Hel Ra Citadel and defeat the ancient warriors who answer.

notes: This trial scales to the Champion Points of the group leader, to a maximum of 160.
